title: Bergen to Flåm: Why the Drive Beats the Cruise
description: Everyone books the fjord cruise and misses the best part. The road from Bergen through Voss to Flåm has a dozen stops that outshine the boat on a clear day — Tvindefossen at dawn, the Stalheim switchbacks, and a goat at a roadside stop that tried to eat my parking ticket. Where to stop, in what order, and how early to leave to beat the tour buses to Nærøyfjord.

comments.comment: The goat thing is universal. One ate half a map out of our hands above Geiranger.
Is the Stalheim road open in early June? Some sites say the old switchback section closes for weather.
Open by late May most years — it's one-way downhill only, so you have to do the loop in the direction I described or you'll miss it.
